🇲🇽🌎 "Evo Morales' government was the best Bolivia has ever had — and the results speak for themselves."

— Claudia Sheinbaum, on US charges against Raúl Castro and persecution of Evo Morales

GDP up. Income up. Poverty down. Inequality down. Sovereignty over natural resources strengthened. Sheinbaum cited ex-president Miguel de la Madrid's memoirs: "The US has always used drug trafficking as a pretext for intervention."

🇲🇽✊ "Mexican women in the US contribute more than a trillion dollars a year."

— Ana Valdez, Latino Donor Collaborative

14.1M Mexican women in the US. 69% workforce participation. 82% focused on building wealth. 1 in 4 women under 18 is Latina — majority Mexican origin. By 2060, 30% of all US women will be Latina.

🇲🇽🏃‍♀️ "We are unstoppable women. Two first places, breaking records."

"Somos mujeres imparables. Dos primeros lugares, rompiendo récord."

— Miriam Morales, Mixtec ambassador, México Imparable

Five indigenous women — two Mixtec, three Rarámuri — competed at the 23rd Great Wall of China Marathon. 60+ countries participated. Gold and silver medals for Mexico.

GDP REVISION: MEXICO'S Q1 CONTRACTION WAS -0.6%, NOT -0.8% — BETTER THAN EXPECTED

INEGI's final Q1 2026 GDP figure: -0.6% quarterly. Beats both the preliminary -0.8% reading and Bloomberg's analyst consensus of -0.8%. Manufacturing took the hit (-1.0%), agriculture fell -1.7%, but the economy proved more resilient than anyone predicted.

Context: this is amid Trump tariffs at historic highs, oil volatility from the Iran conflict, and a global trade war. Mexico's fundamentals held. The EU trade deal signed today adds diversification. Banxico expects adjusted growth below 1% for 2026 — but the recession narrative keeps crumbling one revision at a time.

FIRST BISON BORN IN COAHUILA IN 160 YEARS — MEXICO REWILDING ITS DESERTS

Three American bison calves born this month at El Santuario reserve in Sierra de Menchaca, Cuatro Cienegas. The species had been extinct in the region for 160 years. A herd of 44 arrived in November 2025 — expected to reach 55 by year's end.

Each bison born reinforces species recovery, said Gerardo Ruiz of Fundacion Pro Cuatrocienegas. Bison are essential for prairie ecosystem health — soil recovery, plant diversity. Mexico restoring what colonialism and extractivism destroyed. The land remembers.

USS NIMITZ DEPLOYED TO CARIBBEAN — SAME CARRIER THAT BOMBED IRAQ TWICE NOW AIMED AT CUBA

US Southern Command sent the USS Nimitz carrier strike group to the Caribbean — Carrier Air Wing 17, destroyer USS Gridley, supply ship USNS Patuxent. The announcement came the same day the DOJ indicted 94-year-old Raul Castro.

The Nimitz resume: Desert Storm (~25,000 Iraqi deaths), Iraqi Freedom (~200,000 Iraqi deaths), Inherent Resolve. The command boasted of its unmatched power, presence, precision, and versatility — capable of rapidly deploying combat power anywhere in the world. Cuba calls it what it is: military propaganda preparing scenarios for aggression against the island.

MEXICO'S SCHOLARSHIP SYSTEM NOW REACHES 22 MILLION STUDENTS — 178.2 BILLION PESOS

From 2.8 million students in 2000 with a 4 billion budget to 22 million in 2026 with 178.2 billion invested. A 685% increase in coverage. The Rita Cetina scholarship alone reaches 15.4 million in basic education — nearly 10 million primary students receive 2,500 annually for supplies and uniforms.

National coordinator Julio Cesar Leon called the growth exponential compared to previous administrations. The goal: zero dropouts, universal access. This is what happens when you cut corruption instead of cutting social spending.

250,000 RALLY IN HAVANA AGAINST US ACCUSATION OF RAUL CASTRO — SHEINBAUM CALLS IT OUT

A quarter-million Cubans gathered at the Tribuna Antimperialista Jose Marti today to reject the DOJ indictment of 94-year-old Raul Castro for a 1996 incident — the Brothers to the Rescue downing 30 years ago. Diaz-Canel led the rally with Manuel Marrero and Jose Ramon Machado.

Sheinbaum in the mananera: Que sentido tiene que acusen a alguien por algo que ocurrio hace 30 anos? She also defended Bolivia's Evo Morales against US drug charges — lo acusaron por ser un lider indigena de una zona productora de hoja de coca, no de cocaina. The pattern is always the same.

MEXICO AND EU SIGN HISTORIC TRADE DEAL — 90% OF TARIFFS ELIMINATED

Mexico signed its Modernized Global Agreement with the European Union today at Palacio Nacional — the first update in 26 years. Sheinbaum, Von der Leyen, and Costa sealed three documents: the Global Agreement, an Interim Trade Agreement, and a Strategic Dialogue on global affairs.

86% of agri-food products go tariff-free immediately. Bilateral trade already exceeded €86 billion in 2025, with 13,000+ EU companies invested in Mexico. While Trump builds tariff walls, Mexico builds trade bridges — diversifying beyond US dependency with the world's largest single market.

RESPONSIBLE STATECRAFT: Is the CIA Car Bombing Narcos in Mexico?
May 22, 2026 | 🟢

📰 Rare critical US outlet examining CIA's alleged car bombing of a Sinaloa operative on a Mexican highway in March. Notes the FTO designation gives the CIA legal cover for kill operations. Points out that CNN and NYT used deliberately ambiguous language to obscure who carried out the killing.

Foreign agents are forbidden from operating in Mexico without express permission. Sheinbaum contends the dead CIA officers were illegally invited by Chihuahua's opposition government.

• CNN: the car bomb "was a targeted assassination, facilitated by CIA operations officers"
• NYT: the agency "was not on the ground" — contradicting CNN's account
